I am a graduate student in physics in Paris, following three master's programmes in parallel: Physics of Complex Systems (Université Paris-Saclay), Quantum Information (Sorbonne Université) and Economics & Finance (Université Paris Dauphine-PSL). Before that: MSc Fundamental Physics, first year, mention Bien (Université Paris Cité, 2025–2026); MSc Mathematics, first year; BSc Physics and Mathematics (double major) (Sorbonne Université, 2021–2025); BA Economics and Political Science (Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne, 2022–2025).

    Introduction to mean-field games applied to monetary shocks in a general-equilibrium economy with sticky prices.

Projects

  • Urban morphogenesis, with Raphael Raynaud, Université Paris Cité, Jan 2026
    Agent-based model coupling Schelling segregation with diffusion-limited aggregation: emergent morphologies and fractal dimension; extension with reinforcement learning under way.
